info.name: English Meaning
info.value: to worship, to know, to understand

examples: 'guruvfdDApacAyinaH' (BA॰anu॰145.23). hInatvasampAdakA iti nIlakaRWaH. atrApaSabdo naYarTe. viralatamo'yaM cAyaDAtusahacaritasyApopasargasya prayogaH.
pUjArTe tvasya prasidDiH- 'apacikIhi' (aTarva॰1.10.4). ityatra yaTA. apacikIhIti yaNluki loRmaDyamEkavacane rUpam.
'itastAH sarvA naSyantu kAkA apacitAmiva' (aTarva0 6.25.1). apacitAM pUjitAM pativratAM striyam (prApya).
